verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's marketing pages describe built-in agents for Customer Screening and Ongoing Monitoring and for Transaction Monitoring. They auto-remediate level 1 alerts and escalate high-risk or complex cases for human review, so users can hand alert-triage work to in-product AI. That is delegation within fixed workflows, not an assistant users can direct, and Starter Plan agent configurations cannot be customized. Missing for 10: an interactive assistant users can give arbitrary tasks to, in-depth first-party documentation of agent behavior and controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
